settings.method: Original full-domain DataArrayTexture native sRGB mip chain; exact public GPU copy of sourceLevel=drop+destinationLevel into smaller arrays. Same original UV, geometry, shader, alpha test, linear/trilinear filters, anisotropy, color pipeline and actual 2048 PCF sun shadow pass. Compare every color and packed-shadow RGBA channel with zero tolerance.
settings.gate: Minimum ORIGINAL source texels per physical pixel from the reciprocal maximum singular value of the affine ortho projection Jacobian, across every instance and color+shadow pass. Eligible only when minimumLod >= drop+1; this is a deliberately conservative candidate heuristic, not a portable proof of implementation-dependent anisotropic tap selection.
